event_properties.content: Can you summarise this week's feedback?

This week: **247 total reviews** across all platforms. 68% positive, 18% neutral, 14% negative. Highlights: customers love the new dessert menu. Pain points: parking, wait times on Friday evenings. Net Promoter Score estimate: **+34** (up from +29 last week).
Which menu items are highest in negative feedback?

🍽️ **Top Problem Dishes**
Across all feedback, **Dal Makhni** and **Paneer-based gravies** (Paneer Lababdar, Paneer Butter Masala) drew the most complaints. Customers frequently mentioned watery dal, bland paneer gravies, and hard paneer cubes that felt rushed or poorly prepared.

⚠️ **What Customers Are Saying**
Many guests felt the dal lacked richness and proper tadka, while paneer dishes were described as tasteless or unbalanced. Biryani also surfaced as a concern — diners noticed minimal vegetables, mushy texture, or rice that tasted more like pulao. Starters like Paneer Tikka and Chilli Mushrooms were flagged for being mushy, bland, or not fresh.

✅ **Recommended Action**
Run a kitchen audit focusing on **Dal Makhni** prep (tadka timing, consistency) and **Paneer sourcing** (freshness, cooking method). Consider a tasting session with your team to recalibrate these core menu items before they impact more orders.
Which outlet has the most complaints about Dal Makhni?
**Fly Kouzina** has the most complaints about **Dal Makhni** — customers mentioned it being watery, lacking richness, and tasting off across multiple reviews on both **Zomato** and **Swiggy**.
Which is the most improvement we need to do as brand based on the review?

🎯 **Priority Fix: Food Quality Consistency**
Across all platforms, food quality is your #1 complaint driver — accounting for 12 out of 16 negative reviews. Customers flagged issues like burnt dosas, stale chutneys, watery sambhar, and poor fermentation.

⚠️ **The Real Impact**
This isn't just about taste — it's eroding trust. Guests on **Swiggy** and **Zomato** (your delivery channels) are hit hardest, with complaints about oily food, wrong items, and freshness. Meanwhile, **Google My Business** (dine-in) stays strong at 4.6, showing your kitchen CAN deliver when oversight is present.

✅ **Immediate Action Plan**
Implement a pre-dispatch quality check for all delivery orders — verify crispness, freshness, and correct items before packing. Train your team to treat every delivery order like a dine-in guest is watching. Start with **KANCHIIPURAM BODAKDEV** (rated 2.3) — it needs urgent intervention on prep standards and portion accuracy.
How many customers have complained for food just give me numbers
29 customers flagged **Food Quality** as a concern in their reviews — that's the most mentioned complaint at **Barbeque Spice** this month.

Based on the feedback, **fish** stands out as the dish with the most complaints. Customers frequently mentioned issues like the fish being smelly, not fresh, not cleaned properly, and served cold. Several guests also noted that fish starters were overly oily and poorly prepared, with some even calling it inedible.
